# Python packages CI installs. They live in a requirements file, not inline in
# a workflow's `pip install` line, so Dependabot can see and update them and
# `.github/workflows/security.yml` can audit them. A package pinned inside a
# shell command is invisible to both.
#
# PyYAML: check.sh section 10 parses every eval prompt.md frontmatter. That is
# the only gate catching a case that silently fails to load (poc-planner-how-long
# shipped that way and was never graded).
pyyaml==6.0.4
